# R Street Institute

> A nonpartisan think tank advancing evidence-based policy research and advocacy across criminal justice, energy, technology, and governance.

R Street Institute conducts rigorous policy research and engages federal lawmakers, agencies, and the public through multiple channels including published studies, commentary, testimony, and coalition advocacy. The organization focuses on practical, market-oriented solutions to complex policy challenges.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Justice
- Harm Reduction
- Energy Policy
- Electoral Reform
- Artificial Intelligence
- Governance
- Technology Innovation
- Substance Use Disorder
- Behavioral Health
- Federal Government
- State Policy
- Opioid Policy
- Policy Research
- Government Affairs

## Core Research & Policy

- [Home](https://www.rstreet.org): R Street Institute homepage covering policy research on criminal justice, cybersecurity, and innovation
- [Research Overview](https://www.rstreet.org/research-overview): R Street research overview spanning harm reduction, AI, and behavioral health policy
- [Our Policy Areas](https://www.rstreet.org/home/our-issues): R Street's main policy areas including criminal justice, cybersecurity, and technology
- [America's 250th Birthday Initiative](https://rstreet.org/america250): America250 initiative on civic engagement and democratic institutions

## Research & Analysis

- [Policy Studies](https://www.rstreet.org/research-overview/policy-studies): Policy studies on budget reform, substance use, and algorithmic regulation by R Street
- [Explainers](https://www.rstreet.org/research-overview/explainers): Policy explainers on criminal justice, harm reduction, and opioid policy
- [R Sheets](https://www.rstreet.org/research-overview/r-sheets): Policy brief summaries on criminal justice, electoral reform, and Clean Slate Act
- [External Policy Studies](https://www.rstreet.org/research-overview/external-policy-studies): External research on climate, AI, and energy policy from partner organizations

## Commentary & Engagement

- [Commentary Overview](https://www.rstreet.org/commentary-overview): R Street policy commentary and analysis on AI, energy, and criminal justice
- [Real Solutions Blog](https://www.rstreet.org/commentary-overview/real-solutions): Real Solutions blog covering criminal justice, energy policy, and regulatory reform
- [Op-Eds](https://www.rstreet.org/commentary-overview/op-eds): Op-ed articles by R Street scholars on governance, criminal justice, and policing
- [Newsletters](https://www.rstreet.org/commentary-overview/newsletters): Real Insights newsletter featuring leadership conversations and civic discourse
- [Podcasts](https://www.rstreet.org/commentary-overview/podcasts): Red Tape podcast series on governance, patent policy, and energy environment

## Policy Advocacy & Testimony

- [Outreach Overview](https://www.rstreet.org/outreach-overview): R Street policy advocacy through coalition letters, testimony, and federal engagement
- [Coalition Letters](https://www.rstreet.org/outreach-overview/letters): Coalition letters on electoral reform, electricity policy, and harm reduction
- [Legislative Testimony](https://www.rstreet.org/outreach-overview/testimony): Legislative testimony on criminal justice, energy policy, and electoral reform
- [Regulatory Comments](https://www.rstreet.org/outreach-overview/regulatory-comments): Federal agency submissions on tobacco harm reduction and energy policy
- [Amicus Briefs](https://www.rstreet.org/outreach-overview/amicus-briefs): Supreme Court amicus briefs on online content policy and internet governance

## Events & Connections

- [Events](https://www.rstreet.org/events): R Street events calendar with virtual and in-person policy discussions
